sections.title: Inputs And Classification
sections.text: region required object with type cylinder {origin,direction,radius,height}, ring {origin,direction,outerRadius,innerRadius,height}, box {min,max}, sphere {center,radius}, union {regions:[...]} or body {ref}. points required nonempty array of [x,y,z] length expressions or {point:[...]} objects. boundaryTolerance optional nonnegative length default '0.01 mm'; a point whose signed distance to the region surface is within tolerance is boundary. method analytic (default), native or sampled; samplingBudget positive integer default 10000. schemaVersion required 1. Native body regions use BRepBody.pointContainment on a temporary copy and signed distance to its BRepFace set; TemporaryBRepManager only copies/transforms the body. An unknown SDK result or unavailable measurement remains unknown with a reason. A ring keeps its open channel: the inner cylinder is an exclusion, never filled. No persistent test bodies are created.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.contains',status,success,documentIdentity,units:{length:'cm',angle:'rad'},frame:{space:'component',component},associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,results:[{point,signedDistance,boundaryDistance,classification:'inside'|'outside'|'boundary'|'error'|'unknown',reason?}],counts:{inside,outside,boundary,error,unknown},boundaryTolerance,samplingBudget,samplingUsed,region}. Classification is inside when signedDistance>tolerance, outside when <-tolerance, and boundary otherwise; unclassifiable SDK results are unknown and include a reason. Executor created:[]; read-only. Refs for a body region resolve through the core resolver. Read result.results.N.classification, not a single status, for per-point evidence.

examples.label: Cylinder Boundary And Inside
examples.requires: Open Design document; the three points intentionally sample inside, outside and within-tolerance-of-boundary.
examples.output: result.counts is {inside:1,outside:1,boundary:1,error:0,unknown:0}; result.results.N.classification labels each point.

examples.label: Ring Keeps Its Open Channel
examples.requires: Open Design document; the hole point and the annulus point distinguish the open channel from the solid ring.
examples.output: result.results[0].classification is outside (hole) and result.results[1].classification is inside (annulus).

verified: analytic and native signed-distance classification with boundary tolerance
native BRepBody.pointContainment with explicit unknown results
temporary-copy face-distance refinement and occurrence transform

sections.title: Inputs And Clearance
sections.text: path required array of at least two [x,y,z] waypoints; radius required positive swept-section length. obstacles optional array of {point:[x,y,z]} objects; minimumClearance optional nonnegative length default '0 mm'. sections optional array of {station,clearance?} arc-length stations. schemaVersion required 1. Clearance is the distance from an obstacle to the centerline minus the corridor radius; negative or below-minimum clearance is an intrusion.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.corridor',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,occupancy:[{obstacle,clearance,intrudes,distanceToCenterline}],sections:[{station,position,radius,clearance}],arcLength,radius,minimumClearance,minClearance,intrusions,limits:{length,radius}}. Executor created:[]; read-only. Corridor clearance is geometric swept-section clearance, not CFD.

examples.label: Blade Channel Clearance
examples.requires: Open Design document; the obstacle sits 3 mm from the centerline, within the corridor radius of 2 mm plus 0.5 mm minimum.
examples.output: result.occupancy[0].clearance is 1 mm and intrudes is false; result.minClearance is 1 mm.

sections.title: Inputs And Occupancy
sections.text: region required object (cylinder/ring/box/sphere/union as in measure.contains); occupants required array of {point:[x,y,z],radius?} objects. sections optional array of {z:length} planes reporting occupant count and occupied-union area. samplingBudget positive integer default 200000 for the deterministic grid union-area estimate. schemaVersion required 1.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.region',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,occupancy:[{point,radius,signedDistance,inside,classification}],occupiedCount,occupantCount,sections:[{z,occupantCount,occupiedUnionArea}],samplingBudget,limits}. Executor created:[]; read-only. Occupied-union area is a grid estimate, not an exact analytic union.

examples.label: Box Region Occupancy
examples.requires: Open Design document; one occupant centered inside the box, sectioned at its mid height.
